test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FALF' is written as 'HCJD'. How will 'OEMC' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ee6b909425da283ff67d6d4086a7ad166e25d4ed304be4921fbeb8d0c7f845e.png] ​

Logic: **2 is added in the first two alphabet positional values and 2 is subtracted in the last two alphabet positional values.**

'FALF' is written as 'HCJD' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee577bd4a26e1767ca98b0a42cf0b80165326ab276fb42b02eda5453b83b98b4.png] 

Similarly, 'OEMC' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45808b31f761369b9e6f4327a9471f4d717789114ebde14f11b2e7e821eea433.png] 

Here, 'OEMC' is written as **'QGKA'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
